# Southern Amusement Company, LLC

> Jackson, Tennessee amusement route operator. Places and services coin-operated pool tables, TouchTunes digital jukeboxes (including the Soundwave), vape and Zyn vending machines, and ATMs for bars, restaurants, and entertainment venues across West Tennessee and North Mississippi. Also buys amusement routes and used coin-op equipment from other operators.

Phone: (731) 234-9797. Address: 2000 N Highland Ave, Jackson, TN 38305. Run by managing partners Chase Channell and Bill McDaniel; Bill's father Earl McDaniel entered the coin-op business in 1936.

## Pages

- [Home: services, gallery, about, FAQ, quote form](https://www.southernamusementco.com/)
- [Sell Your Route or Equipment: we buy routes and coin-op equipment](https://www.southernamusementco.com/sell-your-route/)

## Quick facts

- Business model: revenue-share placements with installation, maintenance, and support included. Not a retail equipment seller, though used tables occasionally become available.
- Coverage: West Tennessee, North Mississippi, and surrounding areas.
- Buys: full or partial routes, coin-op pool tables (Valley, Dynamo, Diamond), TouchTunes jukeboxes, electronic dart boards (Arachnid), commercial vending machines, and ATMs on location.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Southern-Amusement-Company-61578609703677/
